learned_rules: Validate four custody layers separately: outer transport -> embedded split chunk -> logical rejoin -> nested required packages.
Stream split members directly into a /tmp logical verifier; do not materialize multiple large standalone chunks unless required.
A healthy outer carrier does not prove an inner chunk or logical DB authority is correct.
Historical embedded bootstrap/CURRENT documents are provenance only and cannot override the current external SYNC-R74 manifest/trust-root/handoff.
If DB59 semantic payload remains unchanged, D1/D2 remain byte-identical and must not be mutated merely because later research advanced.
Visible upload presence is not byte authority; size/SHA/central-directory/CRC/member checks are required.
On ClientError or minimal-command failure: STOP -> RUNTIME_TRANSPORT_HOLD -> MINIMAL_HEALTH_CHECK -> LAST_ATOMIC_CHECKPOINT_VERIFY -> RESUME_ONLY_FAILED_STEP.
Do not call page-cache pressure OOM unless memory.events supports it.

historical_error_relearning.known_truncation_example: Prior D1 mount had 132644864 bytes instead of canonical 138011573 bytes; classify as PHYSICAL_UPLOAD_TRUNCATION, not research/engine failure.
historical_error_relearning.grouped_validation_risk: Large grouped validation previously caused wrapper timeout; use one artifact/one step.
historical_error_relearning.tool_gateway_risk: Intermittent ClientError can occur while local shell/filesystem remains healthy; local success does not prove all gateways healthy.
historical_error_relearning.authority_conflict_rule: If authority conflict cannot be resolved, stop as AUTHORITY_CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED rather than guessing.

mutation_policy: No package mutation/reseal/promotion was performed during this audit.
